Promotion was refused while the class was spelled SwitchActivatedPlank: the TU emitted _ZTI20SwitchActivatedPlank/_ZTS20SwitchActivatedPlank/_ZTV20SwitchActivatedPlank plus the eight inherited base-chain RTTI passengers, while ov029's vtable preamble at 0x0211415c points at a _ZTS reading `15daObjWc_Obj04_c` -- records that cannot be dispositioned against a cartridge address whose spelling they contradict, so all 11 were deliberately left unlicensed. Spelling the class as the cartridge spells it makes them agree (the spawn profile at 0x0211417c is g_profile_WC_OBJ04, so the ROM's own actor id agrees with the RTTI string), and they are now licensed in compiler_only_output as deadstrip-data, each with a canonical ROM home outside this entry's licensed .text 0x02112630-0x0211299c. tools/romdata_check.py --files src/game/actors/d_a_obj_wc_obj04.cpp word-compares all 11 against the cartridge with relocations applied: 6 VERIFIED (184 bytes), 5 PARTIAL (52 bytes), 0 DIFFERS, 0 UNNAMED -- the same split daObjWc_Obj02_c and daObjWc_Obj05_c report. The PARTIALs are extent shortfalls, not disagreements: every byte compared is equal. Why the class's OWN trio is vague linkage here differs from daObjWc_Obj02_c's reason and must not be copied from it: obj02 defines its destructor inline in the class body, so it has no key function at all. obj04's header DECLARES `virtual ~daObjWc_Obj04_c();` out of line -- the first virtual it declares, hence the key function -- but nothing DEFINES it as a C++ member. The cartridge's D1 and D0 are carried in this TU as `// @symbol` marked bodies under their mangled names (`int *_ZN15daObjWc_Obj04_cD1Ev(int *t)`), which the compiler sees as unrelated functions, so the key function is declared-but-undefined and mwccarm emits the trio into every user TU rather than homing it in one. The `#pragma optimize_for_size on` carried in from the legacy Behavior source is now bracketed with an explicit `off` at the tail; its extent (ROM ordinals 6 down to 0) is unchanged and the ROM still builds 106/106 exact. The declared-but-undefined key function is not a choice: defining ~daObjWc_Obj04_c() as a real C++ member was tried and the build refused it. mwccarm emits the D2/D1/D0 triple as one group in the order D0-then-D1, while the cartridge keeps D1 (0x02112630) below D0 (0x0211267c), so objisolate reports `requested functions are not emitted in ROM order`; the group also brings an unhomed _ZN15daObjWc_Obj04_cD2Ev. Separate mangled bodies are the only way to place the two at their ROM addresses, which costs both the CONVERTED tier's no-raw-offset and no-mangled-refs criteria -- banked with that reason in config/converted-backslide-exceptions.jsonl. Marking the two func_ov029_* bodies with `// @symbol` was also needed: tiers scores a member from one marker to the next, so without them CleanupResources' fragment swallowed both raw-offset helpers and backslid too.
